resources.string: The next step of a skill, after an app opens
Teach a skill by voice: “teach a skill called heading home: text Sam I\'m on my way, then open the route home.” Or ask Robot to do something, then say “save that as a skill.”
Robot keeps the file it couldn\'t read aside as skills.json.bad, and you start with no skills.
A skill runs its steps on your phone, one at a time. Each step still shows its own card when its action asks first, so a skill never skips a card. Skills never run on a locked phone.
Remove “%1$s”: its value stays at the default
Then Just do it can be chosen

Up to 3 of your skills are described to Robot\'s model when your words fit them. Off: only their names run them.
Export a skill, import one, and the keys you trust
A skill you export is signed with this phone\'s key, so whoever imports it can see it came from you. A skill you import always starts off, whoever signed it.
Robot can\'t use this phone\'s key now, so it can\'t export skills.
None yet. Add your other phone\'s fingerprint to see its name on the skills it signs.
All 64 digits and letters, from Settings › Skills › Sharing on the other phone
Skills it signs will show its fingerprint instead of its name.
